text:
[REGULAR ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Regular Items 19 - 25]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Award of a Lease to VNY Development II LLC, a Delaware limited liability company wholly owned by Sky Harbour Group Corporation, a Delaware corporation: For an initial five (5)-year term, which may be extended for up to two (2) additional years, with one (1) additional twenty-five (25)-year extension option, for a maximum term of thirty-two (32) years, covering use and potential redevelopment of a general aviation facility located at 16425 Hart Street at Van Nuys Airport, for approximately $29.24 million in total revenue over the maximum term (Jean-Pierre Tabet)
summary: Approval of the Award of a Lease to VNY Development II LLC, a Delaware limited liability company wholly owned by Sky Harbour Group Corporation.

flag.reason: Long-term Sky Harbour lease at Van Nuys Airport.
